description: A two-channel VU meter reading the smoothed RMS of its inputs in volume units, to the ANSI C16.5-1942 standard, shown on two moving needles.

params.text: Sets how much the signal is attenuated before the meter, 0.25x to 16x; at 4x a signal four times as large reads the same on the scale.

inputs.text: The signal metered on the upper needle; with nothing patched into the second input, its second channel is metered on the lower needle.
The signal metered on the lower needle.

notes: the needle takes 300ms to rise to within 99% of a 0dB reading, and overshoots by between 1 and 1.5%, as the ANSI C16.5-1942 standard specifies.
meters placed side by side chain together, passing spare channels to the meter on the right when that one has no input of its own, and copying the load and attenuator settings across.
menu: Load Resistor — a submenu of 150 ohms, 600 ohms and 1000 ohms, with the one in use printed on the item; 0dB is where 1mW is dissipated, about 0.775V RMS into 600 ohms and 1V RMS into 1000 ohms.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
